scripts.build: vp run --filter '!silkpulse' build && pnpm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: mkdir -p packages/server/public && cp packages/sdk/dist/index.iife.js packages/server/public/sdk.js && cp -r apps/console/dist/* packages/server/public/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:devtools: node scripts/devtools-matrix-test.mjs && node scripts/diag-react-vite.mjs && node scripts/diag-vite-spa-preinject.mjs
scripts.test:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:devtools
